image_prompt: A distinguished older woman in cyberpunk anime style, approximately 60-70 years old with sharp, aristocratic features. She has silver-white hair styled in an elaborate updo with geometric precision, adorned with glowing neon circuits and holographic hairpieces in cool blues and purples. Her face is elegant and austere, with high cheekbones, piercing intelligent eyes enhanced with subtle cybernetic implants that glow faintly at the corners. She wears an ornate formal gown combining 18th-century Prussian court elegance with cyberpunk elements: layers of structured silk and synthetic materials in deep burgundy and black, embellished with bioluminescent embroidery patterns and metallic threading that traces geometric designs across the bodice. Her shoulders are dramatically padded with crystalline structures. Around her neck hangs a pendant combining amber with glowing tech elements. Her hands are adorned with elegant rings featuring both jewels and micro-circuitry. Her expression is composed and commanding, reflecting quiet intellectual authority and benevolent severity. The overall aesthetic merges rigid 18th-century German court formality with sleek, angular cyberpunk design elements.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
